written.headline: Nvidia to acquire Hugging Face for $12.93 billion
written.summary: Nvidia confirmed a deal to buy open‑weight AI platform Hugging Face for about $12.93 billion. The acquisition, expected to close in the first half of 2027, will keep the platform open for all developers.

written.headline: Nvidia releases open‑weight Nemotron 3.5 models for enterprise agents and PCs
written.summary: Nvidia announced three new open‑weight Nemotron 3.5 models—a 120‑billion‑parameter Super VL for data‑center agents and two smaller Bolt variants for local PCs. The models can be post‑trained on a company’s own data and run on Nvidia’s RTX Spark‑based AI PCs and DGX Spark workstations.

written.headline: India's AI sector looks to debt financing for data centres amid GPU and regulatory risks
written.summary: A Union Bank of India report says India's AI sector will increasingly seek debt financing to build data centres and computing infrastructure over the next three to five years. The report cites rapid GPU obsolescence, limited domestic hardware manufacturing and evolving AI regulations as key risks.
